exposure: Mood stabilizers (lithium, anticonvulsants, antipsychotics) during pregnancy
Treated-BD (BD with prenatal mood stabilizer use)
Untreated-BD (BD without prenatal mood stabilizer use)
outcome: Maternal somatic hospitalization <= 90 days post-discharge from index delivery
cohort: The study included 465,069 women aged 15-50 years who delivered their first and singleton child in Hong Kong between 2003 and 2018.
finding: Overall, bipolar disorder (BD) and mood-stabilizers were not associated with most adverse pregnancy, delivery, and neonatal outcomes, though BD was specifically linked to increased risks of gestational diabetes and maternal somatic hospitalization postpartum.
followup_time: Up to 90 days postpartum (for maternal somatic hospitalization)
